nodes.title: Overview
nodes.summary: Vectorless is a document indexing and retrieval library. It utilizes tree-based navigation rather than vector embeddings to manage and retrieve documents.

nodes.title: Key Features
nodes.summary: The system organizes documents using hierarchical tree-based indexing and employs an LLM to intelligently traverse the structure for relevant content. This approach eliminates the need for a vector database, thereby reducing infrastructure complexity.

nodes.title: Architecture
nodes.summary: The provided text outlines the architecture of a software crate. It states that the crate is organized into several distinct modules.

nodes.title: Core Module
nodes.summary: The core module provides fundamental types, including `DocumentTree`, an arena-based tree structure, and `TreeNode`, which represents a node in the tree. Additionally, it includes `NodeId`, a unique identifier for tree nodes.

nodes.title: Parser Module
nodes.summary: The parser module handles document parsing using `MarkdownParser`, `PdfParser`, and `HtmlParser` components. Currently, Markdown parsing is available, while the PDF and HTML parsers are planned features.
